caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair with detailed craftsmanship. The chair features a straight, high back with two vertical supports topped by rounded finials and connected by horizontal rods near the top and bottom. The backrest appears to be a flat, rectangular panel colored in a muted brown, framed by the lighter brown wood of the chair frame. The armrests are cylindrical and supported by turned wooden spindles, matching the style of the chair's frame. The seat has a slightly textured, slate gray appearance, contrasting with the mostly warm brown tones of the wood. The legs of the chair are sturdy, resting on a pair of curved rockers joined by two horizontal stretcher bars at the front. A small handle-like mechanism and other hardware are visible at the base of the seat, near the bottom front crossbar. The composition centers the chair on a plain, off-white background with ample empty space surrounding the object, and the text “Weir’s, Improved’s” appears in small black print to the lower right of the chair.
title: Platform Rocker
